verify_detail: it\'s synthetic/injected non-determinism in the app itself, and the UI test is correctly detecting a real (intentional-looking) flaky element rather than suffering from a test-side timing bug.\n\n**Recommendation for the test:** don\'t just add waits — the test needs to either assert on both valid states (button present when "Sync idle", assert its absence when "Sync unavailable" instead of failing), or the app\'s synthetic randomness needs a fixed/injectable seed for deterministic test builds.'
